meta.notes: NI 43-101 PFS golden fixture. Table 22-2 C$ cash-flow rows are converted to canonical USD with the report-locked C$1.35/US$1 assumption. The report-relative axis Y-3..Y16 is preserved exactly. Runtime calendar placement is kept separate and uses Mayfair current guidance for initial production in 2030, which maps report t=0 to 2027 without stretching the economic arrays. Table 21-1/Table 22-1 report C$60.9m sustaining capital while annual Table 22-2 cash-flow rows sum to C$68.2m; the annual cash-flow series is canonical for economic reconciliation and the discrepancy is retained explicitly in test evidence.

productionStart.pageOrTable: Mayfair Gold Jan. 26, 2026 news release: goal of starting construction in 2028 with initial production in 2030
productionStart.notes: Initial production is the sourced runtime anchor. With report productionStartPeriod=3 this places economic t=0 in 2027. The separate company goal to start major construction in 2028 is not treated as report economic t=0 because it is not the same concept as the PFS three-year pre-production cash-flow axis.

runtimePlacement.notes: Current company schedule guidance is used only to place the unchanged report-relative economics on a runtime calendar. No constructionStart or nameplateCapacity calendar anchor is inferred.

reportLockedItems.label: Property NSR royalties

runtimeProxyRule.label: LOM-average NSR royalty proxy
runtimeProxyRule.pageOrTable: Section 22.3.4 p.274; Table 22-1 pp.275-276; Section 4.8 pp.42-43
runtimeProxyRule.notes: Report reconciliation uses the annual royalty residual after separating the disclosed US$5/oz refining/transport charge from Table 22-2 Royalties & Refining Costs. Runtime uses the report-disclosed 1.7% LOM-average NSR because annual claim-level royalty allocation is not disclosed; no property-level production allocation is guessed.

reportLockedItems.notes: The report states approximately C$64m undiscounted LOM royalties and provides only a combined annual Royalties & Refining Costs row. Annual report leg is locked to that row less the independently disclosed US$5/oz refining/transport charge.

taxModel.notes: REPORT: exact rounded Table 22-2 combined mining/provincial/federal tax cash-flow series, including historical tax positions and construction-start tax basis. RUNTIME: simplified 26.5% general corporate income-tax proxy with loss carryforward, equal to the current 15% Canadian federal general rate plus 11.5% Ontario general corporate rate. It does not reconstruct Ontario mining tax, historical tax pools or depreciation basis. Report reconciliation never uses this proxy.

report.npvIrrPageOrTable: Section 22.4 and Table 22-1 pp.274-276; annual cash flow Table 22-2 p.278
report.periodsPageOrTable: Section 21.2.2.1 p.241; Section 22.3 p.274; Table 22-2 p.278
report.assumptionsNotes: 100% project basis; real Q3 2025 C$; C$1.35/US$1; US$3,100/oz Au; recovered gold subject to 99.95% payability; US$5/oz refining and transport; 1.7% LOM-average NSR; 36-month report pre-production cash-flow axis; annual end-period cash flows discounted to start of construction; 100% equity except equipment leases. Table 22-1/21-1 reports C$60.9m sustaining capital, while Table 22-2 annual sustaining cash-flow rows sum to C$68.2m. The annual Table 22-2 series is used for NPV/IRR reconciliation and the discrepancy is explicitly retained rather than balanced away. Runtime calendar placement is separately anchored to Mayfair current guidance for initial production in 2030.
